hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 ≤ T. The nonnegative case uses the existing proof. Otherwise, PositiveIntegral.time T t = max 0 (min T t) = 0 for every t. By the definition of PositiveIntegral.value and hf, f (t,p) is independent of t, so the conclusion is continuity of a constant function. The case T = 0 is already covered by the existing proof.
JetPrototype.Phase = (Transverse × ℝ) × Velocity has a zero element. Evaluating hg at (0,0) gives 0 ≤ |g (0,0)| ≤ S, recovering hS. The existing proof then applies unchanged, including when S = 0.
